notes: The prompt says obby outright, so Obby & Platformer and its genre-wide P6; 'rainbow' is a colour theme on the platforms rather than a second genre or a shape signal. The shape answer picks a flat course along the ground, which is course-flat and the genre default, so Classic Obby applies unchanged with winner-zone added because the goal answer asks for a marked completion area. The scale answer caps it at roughly a minute, so I sized this as a short course with a small platform count rather than a marathon, and kept checkpoint-respawn even though the genre notes allow very short courses to omit checkpoints, since staged rainbow obbies on Roblox are conventionally checkpointed and the option carries no pipeline cost. Nothing here is contact-lethal, so hazard-kill stays off and falling off the coloured path is the failure state.
